name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. The '4f' suffix is the dispatch-table index 0x4F into the per-event handler table @ 0x51B91 (entry @ 0x51ccd contains LE 0x00035ee6 = this function) -- a meaningful domain ID, NOT an address residue (the function's own address 0x35ee6 is unrelated to 4f). 'ch29' and 'dyn_turn_event' accurately describe chapter-29 dynamic-turn-event-scheduler behavior. Matches the file-wide naming convention of all sibling handlers.
purpose: Chapter-29 turn-FF dynamic turn-event handler: re-arms the next turn-event then RNG-picks 2 of the last 3 party slots (primed by handler_4C) and marks them as having acted this turn.
logic_summary: (1) tile_event_data_table[+9] = (uint8)(turn_counter + 1) -- schedule this scene to re-fire one player turn ahead (hook entry 2's turn byte; 8-bit INC of turn_counter per binary). (2) rng = fd2_advance_rng_state() return (captured in EBX; the decompiler's iVar1=__CHK(...) is the EAX-tracking artifact, __CHK return unused). (3) base = tile_event_consumed_flags[0x15] (zero-extended byte; = party_member_count-3, primed by handler_4C). (4) fd2_mark_char_acted_this_turn((rng%3)+base) and fd2_mark_char_acted_this_turn(((rng+1)%3)+base) -- mark two of the last three party slots done for this turn, RNG choosing which pair. %3 is a signed IDIV; rng is 0..0xFFFF so signed==unsigned. Single basic block, cyclomatic complexity 1.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Dispatch-table arg under the shared 1-arg cdecl ABI of the per-event handler table @ 0x51B91. This handler does not read it (disasm reads no [ESP+arg] slot).
params.reason: File-wide convention name for the unread dispatch arg; no address residue, semantics-appropriate.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects only: schedules the next turn-event and marks two party slots as acted-this-turn.

reads_globals: data_fd2_battle_turn_counter (0x53bef, byte read + 8-bit INC for the +9 store)
data_fd2_tile_event_data_table_ptr (0x53a55, base pointer for the +9 turn-byte store)
data_fd2_field_map_tile_event_consumed_flags_ptr (0x53ad5, base pointer; [+0x15] read as RNG base offset)
notes: Disasm @ 0x35ee6 confirms every comment claim: MOV BL,[0x53bef]/INC BL/MOV [EDX+9],BL (8-bit turn+1 byte store); CALL 0x4e893 (fd2_advance_rng_state)/MOV EBX,EAX (RNG return in EBX); MOVZX [EDX+0x15] (base); SAR EDX,0x1f + IDIV ECX=3 + ADD base for (rng%3)+base; LEA EDX,[EBX+1] + IDIV EBX=3 + ADD base for ((rng+1)%3)+base; both CALL 0x13512 (fd2_mark_char_acted_this_turn). Cross-ref verified: handler_4C @ 0x35d60 primes consumed_flags[0x15]=party_member_count-3 (src line 1276-1277) and writes tile_event_data_table[+9]=turn_counter (src line 1278-1279), exactly the [0x15] base and +9 slot this handler reads/re-arms. fd2-knowledge ch29 = endgame escort battle with reinforcements appearing each time the player ends a turn over several turns -- consistent with a repeating per-turn handler. Callee fd2_advance_rng_state (void __cdecl) and fd2_mark_char_acted_this_turn (uint param_1) confirmed by address. Source comment and code already polished/correct; no edits needed.
